thread:
tasha_csm: quick heads-up — greenfield wants a dry-run of their dedicated pool traffic shift next Tue 09:00 PT. primary asks: quota bump for initial ramp, controlled autoscale thresholds, and a 30m failover hold.
raj_engineer: noted. what size bump are they requesting?
emma_cs: they asked for +40% baseline quota for first 24h then roll down. customer will run a mixed workload (chat+embeddings).
miguel_sre: ok for autoscale: recommend target GPU util 65% with burst cap at 90% and queue_depth trigger of 2500 reqs. keep cooldown 120s.
tasha_csm: can we put that into a runbook snippet? i'll send to the customer after we confirm.
raj_engineer: creating snippet now. use this as the autoscale block:
```
autoscale:
  metric: gpu_util
  target: 0.65
  max: 0.90
  cooldown_sec: 120
  queue_trigger: 2500
```
raj_engineer: also request quota delta: baseline_tokens_per_min = 120k -> bump to 168k (40%) for 24h. after dry-run, we'll evaluate.
emma_cs: added customer enablement session 08:30 PT same day for checklist and run through fallbacks.
miguel_sre: load tests — prefer staged ramp: 0->40% in 10m, 40->80% in 20m, hold 30m, then 80->0 in 15m. keep prefix cache warmers running.
tasha_csm: what are the warmup commands for cache?
raj_engineer: run the loader: `./loadgen --model redwood-v1 --pattern prefix_cache --qps 800 --concurrency 64` for 15m before shift.
deploy-bot: [notice] canary-deployment:traffic-shift planned: 2027-06-14T16:00:00Z (dry-run window). :rocket:
emma_cs: small ask: can we enable automatic fallback to a slightly quantized model variant if p95 latency > 1200ms for >5min? customer wants consistency.
miguel_sre: yes — we'll add rule: if p95 > 1200ms for 5m -> route 30% traffic to q4 variant, if still high after 10m -> fallback to 100% q4. log decision in console.
tasha_csm: risk/renewal note: customer expressed concern about burst costs if autoscale spikes. include cost-guard clause: hard quota limit at +80% of baseline unless CS signoff.
raj_engineer: i'll add a policy entry: `hard_quota_limit: baseline * 1.8` with alert to CSM + infra on breach.
emma_cs: tagging ops: @miguel_sre please verify alerts will page on threshold breach. :eyes:
miguel_sre: will do. paging test scheduled Mon 13:00 PT.
tasha_csm: action items:
- raj_engineer: commit autoscale and quota snippets to the bring-up runbook (due EOD Thu)
- miguel_sre: validate alerting + paging test Mon 13:00 PT
- emma_cs: run customer enablement at 08:30 PT day-of
- tasha_csm: confirm dry-run invite + post-run retrospective (owner)
please react with :thumbsup: if assigned.
raj_engineer: :thumbsup:
miguel_sre: :thumbsup:
emma_cs: :thumbsup:

Notes: runbook link https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-traffic-shift (private)
Post-run we will capture health metrics (p95 latency, tokens/min, cost delta) and summarize for renewal health check.

deposit: final question from customer — can we throttle embeddings separately? they want separate quota buckets.
raj_engineer: yes; we can create per-route quotas. create `quota.routes.embeddings` and set initial at 20% of bumped quota.
tasha_csm: perfect. i'll update the customer and confirm tomorrow.
